name: Unassigned
does: An unassigned settler waiting for a job.
hire: Every new settler starts unassigned. Firing a worker returns them here.

name: Farmer
does: Tills, sows and harvests the fields you mark, then stores the wheat.
hire: Buy the Farmer Emblem from the Mayor (2 Coins, 8 Wheat Seeds, 1 Leather).

name: Lumberer
does: Fells trees in its marked work area and brings the logs back to camp.
hire: Buy the Lumberer Emblem from the Mayor (1 Coin, 2 Flint).

name: Guard
does: Patrols, answers the alarm and fights raiders; climbs the ranks up to Captain.
hire: Buy the Guard Emblem from the Mayor (3 Coins, 2 Iron Ingots, 1 Leather).

name: Courier
does: Carries goods between the Banner, the Warehouse and the workshops.
hire: Buy the Courier Emblem from the Mayor (2 Coins, 1 Chest, 2 Leather).

name: Baker
does: Bakes bread from wheat or flour at the Bakery.
hire: Buy the Baker Emblem from the Mayor (2 Coins, 2 Bread, 1 Leather).

name: Cook
does: Cooks mushroom stew, baked potatoes and dried kelp into meals at the Kitchen.
hire: Buy the Cook Emblem from the Mayor (2 Coins, 2 Bowls, 1 Leather).

name: Butcher
does: Cooks raw beef, pork, mutton and chicken, and cures rabbit into Cured Hide.
hire: Buy the Butcher Emblem from the Mayor (2 Coins, 1 Iron Ingot, 1 Leather).

name: Smelter
does: Smelts raw iron, copper and gold into ingots, and logs into charcoal.
hire: Buy the Smelter Emblem from the Mayor (2 Coins, 1 Furnace, 1 Leather).

name: Smith
does: Forges iron blooms into ingots and makes iron axes, pickaxes, hoes and swords.
hire: Buy the Smith Emblem from the Mayor (2 Coins, 2 Iron Ingots, 1 Leather).

name: Sawyer
does: Saws logs into planks and Timber Beams at the Sawmill.
hire: Buy the Sawyer Emblem from the Mayor (2 Coins, 2 Iron Ingots, 2 Leather).

name: Carpenter
does: Makes sticks, barrels and ladders from planks and Timber Beams.
hire: Buy the Carpenter Emblem from the Mayor (2 Coins, 8 Sticks, 1 Leather).

name: Mason
does: Cuts cobblestone into stone and stone into stone bricks.
hire: Buy the Mason Emblem from the Mayor (2 Coins, 16 Cobblestone, 1 Leather).

name: Fletcher
does: Makes arrows from flint or feathers, and bows from string.
hire: Buy the Fletcher Emblem from the Mayor (2 Coins, 4 Feathers, 2 Flint).

name: Weaver
does: Spins string into wool, weaves Wool Bolts and sews banners.
hire: Buy the Weaver Emblem from the Mayor (2 Coins, 4 String, 1 Leather).

name: Tanner
does: Tans Cured Hide and rabbit hide into leather.
hire: Buy the Tanner Emblem from the Mayor (2 Coins, 2 Leather).

name: Miner
does: Digs a shaft below the Mine and brings up stone and ore.
hire: Buy the Miner Emblem from the Mayor (2 Coins, 8 Torches, 1 Leather).

name: Innkeeper
does: Runs the Tavern: serves ale and food to seated guests and cuts the recruit price.
hire: Buy the Innkeeper Emblem from the Mayor (2 Coins, 2 Bread, 2 Leather).

name: Scholar
does: Studies at the Architect's Study to advance your chosen research project.
hire: Buy the Scholar Emblem from the Mayor (2 Coins, 2 Books, 2 Leather).

name: Miller
does: Grinds wheat into flour and sugar cane into paper at the Mill.
hire: Buy the Miller Emblem from the Mayor (2 Coins, 8 Wheat, 1 Leather).

name: Brewer
does: Brews malt and ale from wheat at the Brewery.
hire: Buy the Brewer Emblem from the Mayor (2 Coins, 2 Glass Bottles, 1 Leather).

name: Archer
does: Shoots raiders from the Watchtower; ranks up to Master Archer with practice.
hire: Buy the Archer Emblem from the Mayor (3 Coins, 4 Arrows, 1 Leather).

name: Armourer
does: Makes leather and iron armour for your soldiers at the Armoury.
hire: Buy the Armourer Emblem from the Mayor (2 Coins, 2 Iron Ingots, 2 Leather).

name: Herder
does: Shears sheep, feeds and breeds animals and collects eggs in the Pasture.
hire: Buy the Herder Emblem from the Mayor (2 Coins, 1 Hay Block, 1 Leather).

name: Fisher
does: Fishes from the shore chair and lands fish and rare catches for food and trade.
hire: Buy the Fisher Emblem from the Mayor (2 Coins, 2 String, 1 Leather).

name: Hunter
does: Hunts wild game near the Lodge and brings back meat, hides and feathers.
hire: Buy the Hunter Emblem from the Mayor (2 Coins, 12 Arrows, 2 Leather).

name: Mayor
does: Speaks for the village, sells job emblems and gives a boon from their best attribute.
hire: A founder becomes Mayor when the Banner is raised. Appoint another from a settler's screen.

name: Trade Steward
does: Carries surplus goods from the Trading Post to visiting merchants and sells them for Coins.
hire: Buy the Trade Steward Emblem from the Mayor (2 Coins, 2 Paper, 2 Leather).

name: Spearman
does: Battle role: fights from the second rank with long reach and braces against charges.
hire: Buy the Spearman Emblem from the Mayor (4 Coins, 1 Iron Ingot, 1 Leather).

name: Longswordsman
does: Battle role: a two-handed swordsman who breaks shields and cuts through crowds.
hire: Buy the Longswordsman Emblem from the Mayor (5 Coins, 3 Iron Ingots, 2 Leather).

name: Healer
does: Battle role: tends wounded soldiers in a fight and revives downed players.
hire: Buy the Healer Emblem from the Mayor (3 Coins, 2 Paper, 1 Leather).

name: Rune Mage
does: Battle role: spends rune charges on spells and wards that turn a fight.
hire: Buy the Rune Mage Emblem from the Mayor (6 Coins, 8 Lapis Lazuli, 4 Amethyst Shards, 1 Book).

name: Builder
does: Builds blueprints, defense lines and Upgrade Orders from real delivered materials.
hire: Buy the Builder Emblem from the Mayor (2 Coins, 2 Flint, 8 Sticks).
